sentence_stem: Because the shop was closing soon,
correct_completion: we hurried to buy the last bread.
full_sentence: Because the shop was closing soon, we hurried to buy the last bread.
acceptable_variants: we ran to the bakery as fast as we could.
we rushed to get there before the doors closed.

options.text: we walked slowly through the park.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the urgency implied by 'soon' and does not follow logically from the reason given.

options.text: the shop was on the other side of town.
options.why_wrong: This describes location but does not complete the cause-effect link set up by 'because'.

options.text: we hurried to buy the last bread.
the bread was baked in the morning.
options.why_wrong: This gives background information but not a result of the reason in the stem.

explanation: After 'because', the stem gives the reason, so the main clause must describe the action that follows from it. Ukrainian speakers may place a result clause with 'so' in the wrong position, so check that the reason and the result are in the right order.
translation: Оскільки магазин незабаром зачиняється, ми поспішили купити останній хліб.
